description: Search the Library of Congress digital collections by keyword. Optionally filter by material format (photos, maps, newspapers, audio, etc.), date range, subject heading, or geographic location, or scope the search to a single curated collection with collection_slug. Returns item summaries with titles, dates, descriptions, LOC IDs, and format tags. Each result carries is_item: pass the id of a result where is_item is true to libofcongress_get_item for full metadata. Non-item resources include collections, exhibit and research-guide pages, newspaper pages, catalog.loc.gov records, and hdl.loc.gov finding aids. When page_url is present, pass it to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page, optionally using the search query as match; its item_id identifies the issue. A link_notice warns that a retired catalog URL no longer opens its record; otherwise follow a non-item url. Use libofcongress_search_subjects to find an LCSH heading for the subject filter. To discover the subject and location values the filters accept for a search, set include_facets to get its top subject_facets and location_facets.

collection_slug.description: Scope the search to one curated collection. Pass a slug exactly as returned by libofcongress_browse_collections to libofcongress_search_items.collection_slug (e.g., "aaron-copland") — slugs are not derivable from the collection title. Combine with format to filter material type; use query "*" to browse every matching record. Omit to search all of LOC.

date_end.description: End year for date filter, inclusive (e.g., 1930). Omit to run through the current year.

date_start.description: Start year for date filter, inclusive (e.g., 1920). Omit for no lower bound.

format.description: Material type filter. Options: photo, map, newspaper, manuscript, audio, film, book, notated-music. Omit to search all formats.

include_facets.description: Also return subject_facets and location_facets: LOC's top subject and location terms across every match, with counts — the values the subject and location filters accept. Default false: facets add time to each search, so request them when you need filter values to narrow by.

limit.description: Results per page. Default 25. A page holds at most 100 results: a larger limit (up to 1000) is served as a 100-result page, and page then counts 100-result pages.

location.description: Geographic location filter (e.g., "oklahoma", "washington d.c."). Lowercase, matches LOC location facets; location_facets (include_facets) lists values for a search.

query.description: Full-text search across metadata and available descriptive text. Use "*" to match all records within the applied filters; relevance order can differ from a queryless LOC browse.

sort.description: Result order: relevance (default), date (oldest first), or date_desc (newest first). Uses LOC catalog dates and upstream ordering.

subject.description: Subject filter: an LCSH heading from libofcongress_search_subjects (e.g., "World War, 1939-1945", "United States--History--Civil War, 1861-1865") or a subject term from subject_facets (include_facets) or libofcongress_get_item subject_terms (e.g., "world war"). LOC indexes headings by their parts, so the value is split at "--" into lowercase terms with dates dropped, and an item must carry every term.

name: libofcongress_search_items

effectiveCollectionSlug.description: The collection the search was scoped to, after trimming. Absent when the search covered all of LOC.

effectiveLimit.description: The page size actually served when limit exceeded the per-call cap of 100. Absent when limit was within the cap.

effectiveQuery.description: The query as submitted to the LOC API, after trimming.

effectiveSort.description: Applied LOC result order, including empty and out-of-range pages.

effectiveSubjectTerms.description: The subject terms the subject filter was sent as, all required to match. Absent when no subject filter was given.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: date_start is later than date_end, or date_start is given alone and is later than the current year. `collection_not_found`: collection_slug does not resolve to a LOC collection. Reported on page 1; a later page gets the out-of-range notice, since LOC answers both cases the same way there. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. `server_busy`: More Library of Congress requests are queued on this server than can start within this call's time budget. `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress could not be reached, or answered with an error status, a bot challenge or other HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: True when a retrievable next page follows this one. Never promises a page past LOC's ~100,000-item retrieval ceiling.

items.description: Item summaries matching the search query and filters.

date.description: Publication or creation date as LOC catalogs it: free text, a year, or a full date (e.g., "c1915 Feb. 19.", "1912"). Absent when LOC records only a coded value ("uuuu", "||||") or none.

format.description: Material format (e.g., photo, map, manuscript, collection).

id.description: LOC identifier for this result: an item ID, or the bare LCCN of a record whose url is an lccn.loc.gov permalink. When is_item is true, pass it to libofcongress_get_item for full metadata. When is_item is false it is a non-item resource (a collection, exhibit, guide, newspaper page, catalog.loc.gov record, or hdl.loc.gov finding aid), not a get_item input. Use page_url for newspaper pages, heed link_notice for retired links, and otherwise follow url.

is_item.description: True when this result is a catalog item whose id resolves through libofcongress_get_item, including records LOC links by an lccn.loc.gov permalink. False for collections, exhibits, research guides, newspaper pages, catalog.loc.gov records, hdl.loc.gov finding aids, and other non-item results, which have no get_item record. Use page_url for newspaper pages, heed link_notice for retired links, and otherwise follow url. Always present on every result.

link_notice.description: Warning that a retired catalog URL no longer opens its record; no replacement record URL is known.

page_url.description: Recognized newspaper page URL: pass to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page as page_url, optionally with this search query as match. That tool returns item_id for the issue.

url.description: Original LOC result URL, preserved even when retired; read link_notice before following it.

location_facets.description: LOC's top location terms across every item matching this search (up to 10), most frequent first. Pass a value as the location filter to narrow the search. Present only when include_facets is true; empty when LOC reports none.

count.description: Matching items carrying this location term.

value.description: The location term, as the location filter accepts it.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty or a page is out of range — echoes applied filters, subject terms and location included, and suggests how to broaden — plus disclosure of a capped limit or of the retrieval ceiling. Absent on ordinary result pages.

pages.description: Total retrievable pages. For result sets larger than LOC will page through (~100,000 items) this is capped, and a notice discloses how to reach the rest (partition by date/subject/location).

subject_facets.description: LOC's top subject terms across every item matching this search (up to 10), most frequent first. Pass a value as the subject filter to narrow the search. Present only when include_facets is true; empty when LOC reports none.

count.description: Matching items carrying this subject term.

value.description: The subject term, as the subject filter accepts it.

total.description: Total number of matching items across all pages.

totalCount.description: Total matching items across all pages — mirrors output.total for agent reasoning.

title: Search LOC Items
